narrative_prose: Silas examines the crimson and amber glows cutting through dawn shadows as the rhythmic, heavy thud of pneumatic hammers fills the air, leaving a sharp ozone and molten brass tang in his mouth. The oppressively hot and dry air makes him sweat as he adjusts the thermal baffle to DEFEND against the radiant heat. He attempts to ATTRACT stray droplets back into alignment before deciding to CONCEAL his mistake in the scrap pile. Silas grips the physical baton tightly, feeling the Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea challenge his balance, before finally placing it into Hector's waiting hand.
